title: Gateways stopped reporting after firmware update
description: Around 200 trucks went silent overnight after the automatic update to firmware 4.2.0. Units show a solid amber LED. Dispatch has no live positions.
resolution: Rolled back affected gateways to 4.1.3 from the Fleet Portal as described in KB-0001. All units reporting again within the hour.

title: Request for quote on 300 additional gateways
description: Customer is expanding into Poland and wants pricing for 300 extra Gateway G2 units, to be included in the renewal negotiation.

title: Freezer probes reading two degrees warm
description: Food-safety auditor flagged that three freezer trucks report temperatures about 2 degrees higher than the reference thermometer.
resolution: Two probes had a constant offset and were corrected with a calibration offset in the Fleet Portal. One probe drifted over time and was replaced under warranty.

title: Charged twice for February
description: Finance received two invoices with the same amount for the February billing period. The billing contact had updated the company card that night.
resolution: Duplicate invoice voided and credit note issued. Customer chose to keep the overpayment as credit on the next invoice.

title: Users cannot sign in with SSO
description: All users receive 'Invalid SAML response signature' since this morning. The identity team rotated certificates over the weekend.
resolution: Customer admin signed in with a local admin account and switched SSO configuration to the metadata URL so certificates refresh automatically.

title: Validation package for firmware 4.2.1
description: Quality team needs release notes, test evidence and a checksum list for firmware 4.2.1 before approving rollout. Automatic updates must stay disabled until approval.

title: Export job returning 429 errors
description: Nightly integration fails with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. Their script polls job status every second for 40 parallel jobs.
resolution: Advised to respect Retry-After, poll every 10 seconds and switch to the bulk export endpoint. Failures stopped the following night.

title: Work orders not syncing from the field
description: Several engineers report the pending changes counter stuck at 3 to 8 even after returning to the depot with good Wi-Fi.
resolution: Affected devices were on app version 7.1 and had photo attachments above 25 MB. Upgrading to 7.3 released the sync queue. No data lost.

title: Export timestamps one hour off
description: Work order completion times in their BI reports are one hour earlier than what engineers recorded, starting the last weekend of March.
resolution: Export timestamps are UTC; their BI tool assumed local time and broke at the daylight-saving change. Customer now passes tz=Europe/London.

title: Engineer lost work after reinstalling app
description: An engineer uninstalled and reinstalled the app to fix a sync issue and two completed work orders disappeared.
resolution: Unsynced changes are only stored on the device, so the work orders could not be recovered. Customer re-entered them and shared guidance with engineers not to reinstall while changes are pending.

title: Gateways offline in rural areas
description: Harvesters lose connectivity for hours in remote fields and do not come back online after coverage returns. Firmware 4.2.0 installed last week.
resolution: Same reconnect regression as firmware 4.2.0. Rolled back to the previous version and scheduled 4.2.1 once released for Brazil.

title: Portuguese translation errors in Fleet Portal
description: Several menu labels in the Fleet Portal appear in English or use European Portuguese terms that dispatchers find confusing.

title: Nightly export throttled
description: Data warehouse load fails intermittently with 429 responses when pulling the previous day of reefer telemetry with paged requests.
resolution: Moved the job to the bulk export endpoint, which returns one compressed file per day. Throttling no longer occurs.

title: Reefer temperature spikes during defrost
description: Compliance report shows short temperature spikes every six hours on several trailers. Customer suspects faulty probes.
resolution: Spikes match the reefer defrost cycle and are real readings, not sensor drift. Recommended annotating defrost windows in the compliance report instead of replacing probes.

title: Extend telemetry retention to five years
description: New regulation requires five years of temperature history. Customer asks whether retention can be extended beyond the default.

title: Duplicate invoice after card change
description: Customer finance escalated a second invoice for January. Both were paid automatically. They want a refund, not credit.
resolution: Duplicate voided, credit note issued and refund processed to the original card within 7 business days. Account owner followed up with the CFO.

title: Technicians cannot attach photos
description: Uploading photos of broken equipment fails with a generic error on older Android tablets.
resolution: Tablets were on app 7.0 with camera resolution set to maximum, producing files above 25 MB. Upgraded to 7.3, which compresses images before upload.

title: Data subject deletion request for former engineer
description: Data protection officer requests deletion of all personal data for a former field engineer, including name and mobile device identifiers.
resolution: Personal data deleted within 22 days and confirmation posted in the case. Device telemetry kept because it is not linked to the engineer.

title: SSO login loop for some users
description: A subset of users is redirected back to the login page after authenticating. Only users in a newly created security group are affected.

title: Priority 1 response time missed
description: Customer complained that a Priority 1 outage reported on a Sunday got a first response after three hours.
resolution: As a Strategic account they are entitled to 24x7 Priority 1 coverage with a 1 hour target. Case escalated, root cause was a misrouted phone queue, which was fixed.

title: New gateways never come online
description: Forty newly installed gateways at the Pilbara site show a blinking red LED and never appear in the Fleet Portal.
resolution: Corporate firewall was performing TLS inspection. Central IT excluded the telemetry and update hostnames from inspection and the units connected immediately.

title: Proxy configuration for remote site
description: Security policy requires all outbound traffic from the new processing plant to go through an authenticated proxy.
resolution: Proxy configured in the Fleet Portal network settings before devices were shipped. Confirmed outbound TCP 443 and UDP 123 are the only ports needed.

title: Haul truck export missing night shift
description: Daily export appears to be missing data from 18:00 onwards. Site operates on Australian Western Standard Time.
resolution: Data was present but timestamps are UTC, so the night shift landed in the next day's file. Customer now uses the tz parameter with Australia/Perth.

title: Formal quote needed for renewal tender
description: Procurement needs a formal quote for a two-year renewal including 50 additional mobile licences, at least 60 days before the tender deadline.

title: Mobile app sync stuck after update
description: After a phone OS update, the pending changes counter stays at 1 on several devices.
resolution: Forced sync by pulling down on the work order list. Logs sent from Settings > Help showed a stale session token, which the app now refreshes in 7.3.2.
